semantics: App self-schema dependencies #321-906 include indexed shot family/history, composite owner-scoped FK enforcement, personal recipe families, grinder calibrations and bag-history integrity. Source-existing shot->bag relation is necessary to preserve historical records, not a safe unused-table deletion.

Community-shots style/family compound FK references recipe_families(coffee_id,style,id); member recipe preferences link to scoped family, setup version, favorite shot, and calibration relations. Structural references support isolation, but not runtime RLS assurance.

All 220 apparent 'no-schema' references are function-to-PL/pgSQL language, objects-to-namespace, and similar PostgreSQL catalog metadata. They are NOT dangling unresolved objects or orphaned relationships.
PostgreSQL pg_depend does not enumerate all plpgsql body table/function callsites or JavaScript Edge callers, therefore no dead-code/index-drop decision follows from this graph alone.
Paired AUTO and NORMAL dependencies for each CHECK/FOREIGN KEY are PostgreSQL metadata behavior, not proof of duplicate constraints.
Recheck original full function/source/table receipts and independently accepted #96 Auth/privacy testing before any index or FK change; none is safe solely from this metadata.
